test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As of 2022, according to the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas of the Government of India, how many oil refineries are there in India in total?
solution:
The correct answer is __**23**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas of the Government of India, there are **23 oil refineries** in India as of 2022.
 
• These refineries are a mix of both public sector and private sector enterprises.
 
• The oil refineries are strategically located across different states to cater to the energy needs of the country.
 
• India's oil refining capacity plays a crucial role in ensuring energy security and meeting the domestic demand for petroleum products.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first oil refinery in India was established in Digboi, Assam, in 1901.
 
• Indian Oil Corporation (IOC), Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL), and Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) are some of the major public sector companies operating oil refineries in India.
 
• Reliance Industries Limited and Nayara Energy are key private sector players in the oil refining sector.
 
• India is not only self-sufficient in refining petroleum products but also exports a significant amount of its refined products to various countries.
